hits.title: Gift returns without a receipt
hits.snippet: Gifts returned without a receipt are eligible for store credit only, within 30 days of purchase. No refund to the original payment method.

output.answer: Thanks for asking about our return policy for gifts without a receipt. Under our gift return policy, returns are handled within 30 days of purchase. Store credit is one of the options available under the returns policy. For a gift returned without a receipt, you will receive a full refund to the original payment method once the return has been processed within 30 days.
